creatorEvidence.notes: Public CA3D creator channels and independent listings identify CA3D as the sculptor/designer of a Johnny Silverhand Cyberpunk figure matching the reviewed standing pose with cigarette and guitar.

mediaReview.notes: All six exact staged renders are distinct views of the same standing Johnny Silverhand figure. No unrelated third-party promotional badge, Telegram/group branding, reseller URL, QR code, repost handle or source watermark was observed. Cyberpunk/Samurai marks visible on the sculpt/base are part of the depicted model design, not an overlay watermark.

identityReview.notes: The only published Johnny Silverhand candidate is a seated chair diorama. The reviewed CA3D model is standing on a circular Cyberpunk base with guitar; pose, base and composition are materially different.

decision.nextGate: validate batch 009 exact deterministic identity and six clear staged images in release preflight; production apply remains explicitly gated
